APPROVE

The nested ternaries, the `if`, and the lambda all moved into `RegisterApplier`, which should put `BuildPlan` well under 15 by my estimate. Dropping `var m = method;` is safe because a `foreach` variable is captured per iteration, and `continue` became an equivalent early `return`. I couldn't see the rest of the file, so I assumed `using System.Reflection` is already present and that the `appliers` dictionary type matches the new parameter.
